allowedOrigins.title: Sites to scan for phone numbers
allowedOrigins.description: Match patterns such as *://app.jobdiva.com/*. Each user still approves host access once; the options page shows these as set by your administrator.

openIn.title: Where a clicked number opens
openIn.description: 'desktop' (ACE Dialer app) or 'web' (dialer.aptask.com). An open web dialer tab is always used first.
